We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1679747) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2). The template is from make_4_lvl2-template_search-1, with mapped_rxn given. We need to apply the template to the target molecule (the product) to get possible precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id, returns possible outcomes (precursors). Let's call it.
